subject: environmental-science
title: Recycling & Waste: Foundations
welcome_lead: Less waste in the bin means less waste in nature.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: 3 Rs, recycling, landfill.
final_note: Reduce first, reuse second, recycle third.

concepts.def: Use less in the first place.
Turn old stuff into new stuff.
Big hole where waste is buried.
Burning waste, sometimes to make energy.

walkthroughs.body_html: The 3 Rs rank best to worst. Reduce what you buy. Reuse what you have. Recycle what you can't reuse.
What's left goes to landfill — a buried waste site. Some sites capture methane to make electricity, but landfills fill up.
Incineration burns waste. Heat can drive turbines. Filters catch some pollution but emissions are still a problem.
